from qiskit_optimization.algorithms import MinimumEigenOptimizer
from qiskit.primitives import AerSimulator
from qiskit.algorithms.optimizers import SPSA
from qiskit_aer.primitives import Estimator
from qiskit.primitives import Sampler
from qiskit_optimization.translators import to_docplex_mp

def solve_telescope_scheduling():
    # Define the quadratic program
    qp = QuadraticProgram(name="Telescope Scheduling")

    # Add binary variables
    for i in range(1, 6):
        qp.binary_var(name=f"x{i}")

    # Add objective function
    qp.minimize(linear={f"x{i}": -value for i, value in enumerate([4, 5, 3, 6, 2], start=1)})

    # Add equality constraint: x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 = 3
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={f"x{i}": 1 for i in range(1, 6)}, sense="=", rhs=3, name="equality_constraint")

    # Add conflict constraint: x2 * x4 = 0
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={"x2": 1, "x4": 1}, sense="<=", rhs=1, name="conflict_constraint")

    # Convert the quadratic program to QUBO
    qubo_converter = QuadraticProgramToQubo()
    qubo = qubo_converter.convert(qp)

    # Set up the optimizer
    optimizer = SPSA(maxiter=100)
    sampler = Sampler(primitive=AerSimulator())
    estimator = Estimator(primitive=AerSimulator())
    min_eigen_solver = MinimumEigenOptimizer(estimator=estimator, sampler=sampler, optimizer=optimizer)

    # Solve the QUBO
    result = min_eigen_solver.solve(qubo)

    # Extract results
    feasible_objective_quality = result.fval / -13  # Negate the objective value for maximization
    constraint_violation_rate = result.status.value / 100  # Assuming status values range from 0 to 100
    penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy = result.fval
    runtime = result.time

    return {
        "feasible_objective_quality": feasible_objective_quality,
        "constraint_violation_rate": constraint_violation_rate,
        "penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy": penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy,
        "runtime": runtime,
        "evaluation_cost": evaluation_cost,
        "achieved_value": achieved_value,
        "selected_targets": selected_targets
    }
